syllabus_topics: Planning, control, and execution of industrial works

assessment_methods.method: Participation in theoretical and practical sessions (progressive evaluation)
Continuous portfolio work and defense (progressive evaluation)

assessment_rules: Students are evaluated either through a progressive evaluation procedure or a global theoretical-practical exam. The progressive evaluation accounts for 100% of the final grade and includes participation in theoretical and practical sessions, as well as the completion and defense of a continuous portfolio. The global evaluation also accounts for 100% of the final grade and consists of a theoretical-practical exam. Spelling errors in assignments and exams will be penalized by a maximum of 10% of the test grade. Academic fraud, including unauthorized use of materials or electronic devices during assessment, may result in immediate exam withdrawal, a grade of 0, and disciplinary action.
